subject: Our impact page and the report PDF

messages.text:
Dear Luis,

Thank you all for Tuesday's walkthrough of the build. Ruth came back to the office saying it was the first time she could picture the new site properly, which from Ruth is high praise.

Two things, if I may. Ruth has approved the homepage layout. Graham and Priti from the trustees' digital group have seen the desktop draft of the Our impact page but still need to see how it looks on a phone, so could that come to me when it's ready?

Secondly, the printed annual report arrives from Fold & Bind on Monday. We'd love the PDF to sit on the new Our impact page, and on the current site in the meantime. I've attached our comms team's intro text for the page. It's long, I know. Zainab, I'd be grateful for your red pen.

Warmly, Helen

Helen Ashby
Director of Communications
Brightwell Trust - every child a reader
For press enquiries: press@brightwelltrust.example

Hi Helen,

I've cut the intro from 210 words to 90 and kept your opening line about the 120 schools, because it's the best sentence in it. Tracked changes attached. One question back: the draft says both "reading volunteers" and "volunteer readers". Which do you use? The report says reading volunteers on every page but one.

Z

Zainab Bello
Content Designer, Acme Studio
acme.example

Hi Luis,

On the report PDF, before Monday:
- the print file is 38 MB, too heavy to put on a page. Can Kasia export a web version (RGB, under 5 MB)?
- I'll put it in `/media/reports/` on the new site and link it from Our impact and the footer
- the old site can just take a direct link in the News sidebar, no template change needed

Anil

Hi Helen,

We’ll use Zainab’s cut and stick with ‘reading volunteers’. I’ll get the phone screenshots to you next week. Kasia’s making a smaller PDF for us to put up when the boxes arrive.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Dear Luis,

The boxes arrived from Fold & Bind this morning and I'm afraid the cover isn't right. The green is much yellower than the proof Ruth signed off, almost lime next to our logo, and it looks a different colour from the inside pages. Ruth has seen it and agrees. The inside pages look lovely, so please pass our thanks to Kasia and Zainab for those.

Could you speak to Fold & Bind? We were planning to send copies to our major donors at the end of the month. And please hold the PDF until we know what's happening, just in case.

Warmly, Helen

Helen Ashby
Director of Communications
Brightwell Trust - every child a reader
For press enquiries: press@brightwelltrust.example

Hi Helen,

Terry at Fold & Bind will reprint the 2,000 covers at their cost and rebind, and he's promised them back to you by Friday 22 November. Kasia brought a copy back to the studio this afternoon and you're right: it's well off the Pantone 7741 C on the proof. That one's on the printer.

The PDF is our file, so the green in it is correct. Up to you whether it goes up now or waits for the reprint.

Thanks,
Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Dear Luis,

Thank you, that's a weight off. The 22nd still gives us time for the donor mailing, just.

Ruth is happy for the PDF to go up now. Graham pointed out that nobody reads a cover online anyway, which is very Graham. Priti and Graham are both still waiting to see the phone version of Our impact before they sign it off, so I'll keep an eye out for that.

Warmly, Helen

Helen Ashby
Director of Communications
Brightwell Trust - every child a reader
For press enquiries: press@brightwelltrust.example

Hi Helen,

The report is live on the current site:
- News sidebar, "Annual report 2024 (PDF, 4.2 MB)"
- on staging it's in `/media/reports/`, linked from Our impact and the footer

Anil

Hi Helen,

Phone version of Our impact attached for Graham and Priti, two screenshots as it's a long page. It has Zainab's new intro in it.

Thanks,
Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR

Hi Helen,

Content freeze is this Friday, 24 January, at 5pm. After that, changes go on a list for after launch rather than straight onto staging, so Anil can test a site that stays still.

The checklist attached has every page and what's still missing. It's down to two things now: the three volunteer stories, and the trustees' bios. Everything else is in and checked by Zainab.

Launch is still pencilled for early March, and we'll fix the exact day once the freeze is done.

Thanks,
Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

Dear Luis,

Thank you, the checklist is very clear and has been pinned to the wall by my desk. Mira will send the three volunteer stories tomorrow morning. The trustees' bios are attached: Ruth has approved all of them except Graham's own, which he still needs to see, and he's promised to do that by Thursday.

One more thing, and I'm sorry it's arriving two days before the freeze. At last night's board meeting the trustees asked for a donate button on every page, not just on Support us. Priti was quite firm about it; she says people decide to give on the story pages, not on the page about giving. Is that something we can still do, or does it count as a change after the freeze? I'd rather know now than promise them something you can't do.

Warmly, Helen

Helen Ashby
Director of Communications
Brightwell Trust - every child a reader
For press enquiries: press@brightwelltrust.example

Hi Luis,

On the donate button:
- in code it's small, it would live in `SiteHeader` so it's on every page
- but the header is already full at 375px on mobile, so something has to move or we need a different pattern
- also needs a decision on where it goes: straight to their GiveRoute page, or to our Support us page first

It's a design question before it's a build one. I wouldn't count it against the freeze, it's layout, not content.

Anil

Anil, leave `SiteHeader` for now. I’m away from lunchtime tomorrow until the 31st. I’ll do a couple of options the week of 3 Feb and get back to Helen then.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR

Dear Luis,

Your colleague Miss Whyte came down to look round the barn on the 28th of May, and mentioned in passing that you sometimes take clients to dinner away from London. I hope you will forgive a direct approach.

We are holding a small summer supper on Thursday the ninth of July for people who arrange this sort of evening, in the barn at seven o'clock, with a look round the bedrooms beforehand for anyone who would like one. The food is cooked in the farmhouse kitchen from whatever the farm and the neighbours have that week. There is a train from St Pancras that reaches Faversham at a quarter past six, and we would collect you from the station.

If you would like to come, and to bring a colleague, a line in reply is all I need.

With kind regards, Rupert Ashdown
